previousRule: Protected production changes require an APPROVED GitHub review from Nylon1 on the exact PR HEAD, which the sole collaborator cannot submit on their own PR.
newRule: Protected production changes require an authenticated GitHub PR comment from Nylon1 containing OWNER_APPROVED_POLICY_CHANGE and the exact current HEAD SHA; both required production checks remain in force.
reason: The single-owner repository cannot satisfy its own reviewer requirement, so the protected policy check needs an owner action GitHub can verify without accepting a stale or forged approval.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner instructed Codex to replace the impossible self-review requirement with an exact-HEAD owner comment and reserved the one-time bootstrap merge for manual action.
